reviews.title: High pitched ringing
reviews.text: Was kinda enjoying it until I started to get a headache, thought I was hearing my own tinnitus but took one of the pieces out and realized just how loud this constant ringing was, made the Friday nightlife of Portland sound like a whisper, at least for a moment.

reviews.title: Bad
reviews.text: Not a good app 0 out of 10. Doesn’t mask noise and it says it does. Total waste of time and money.

reviews.title: Blue tooth connection fails
reviews.text: Since the last “update” bluetooth no longer connects to the sleep buds once they come out of the case.

reviews.title: Data rarely transfers
reviews.text: Sleep data constantly fails to transfer. For how much the sleepbuds cost, I had much higher expectations.

reviews.title: K9seal
reviews.text: I had the Ozlo, had issue with volume.  Not very impressed with customer support but I really need to get sleep and these are the most comfortable ones I have tried.  So I’ll take a chance on the Ozlo 2.  Great so far

reviews.title: Best sleep ever!!
reviews.text: I had high hopes, but low expectations.  Now I know and love these sleep buds!!  Thank you! 😊😊

reviews.title: Recent update made them unusable
reviews.text: Since one of the recent updates, my Ozlo Sleepbuds no longer stay connected to stream apps (podcasts, music, audiobooks) or even to the charging case. The connection drops constantly and then won’t reconnect without going through a whole bunch of resetting steps — which only allows it to reconnect for just a few seconds before disconnecting yet again. They are completely unusable now. Based on the sheer volume of users here saying the same thing, this seems to be a known issue that is being ignored while they push their 2.0 version. Utterly disappointing.

reviews.title: android app is so dumbed down ?
reviews.text: very not cool that $300 earbuds have more features on the iphone app than the android. my mom just bought these and without me having an iphone she wouldn't have known all the features she is missing out on. it basically makes her $300 earbuds junk and bricked ! why tf is that? never seen that in my life where there's such a disparity between the apps.

reviews.title: Great, until they aren’t
reviews.text: Love these when they work. Unfortunately, they seldom do. I’ve had three sets and they are all the same. Fantastic for a few weeks and then nothing but trouble. One won’t come on (sometimes the left and sometimes the right) or neither will come on, or they come on and then drop after about one minute. My wife has a pair, and it is the same thing. They are so bad that I just give up and don’t even try them for weeks at a time. Then I’ll try and they still don’t work. But sometimes they do! And they are awesome! But that only lasts a couple of days.

reviews.title: The app is useless
reviews.text: So the buds work as they are supposed to but the app sucks. I can’t download any new sleep or alarm sounds (merely hit the preview play button) and it takes an engineering degree in rocket science to even figure out to select your sleep sound. Both times I have “stumbled” upon it and can’t remember which direction to the magic mystery doorway that I stumbled through. I’ve not tried customer support. It’s set to sensor, I begin listening to my podcast and fall fast asleep and it takes over with the sleep sound perfectly and plays all night…it’s just not a sound I want to listen to night after night. I like variety! And this morning I woke before the alarm but can I find where to turn that off? Vekk no. This app needs a LOT of work. It is useless!

reviews.title: Love this
reviews.text:
I use the ozlo sleepbuds 2 - been using them for a week now

Tried the soundcore a20, zykhon cheap buds, liberty soundcore - even my AirPods Pro

My problem is terrible tinnitus

The main issues with other brands is a) shaky connectivity b) they ALWAYS fall out c) the other tends to clog with earwax and are impossible to clean out

The Ozlos are the first I’ve tried that stayed in, are comfortable for a side sleeper, and last all night and have rock solid connectors 

Haven’t had to clean them yet but I’ve read it’s better than the others

So far they’ve been worth the premium - thanks Ozlo!

reviews.title: New update with bugs
reviews.text: Unable to use the simple streaming feature, where Bluetooth stops after 10 minutes, since the new update. So frustrating because I don’t want this additional WiFi exposure while I’m sleeping. Customer support has been little help.

reviews.title: App not connecting to other apps in new update
reviews.text: The new update seems to have a bug. Recently sleepbuds are connected, but only momentarily work for playing audio on another app. No issues with the soundscapes, but I have been unable to listens to any audiobooks or podcasts which are preferable to me to actually fall asleep and the reason I purchased them.

reviews.title: Where’s the snooze??
reviews.text: Loved the app until the update removed the snooze feature.

reviews.title: Thank you Ozlo!
reviews.text: I have used the Ozlo sleep buds for a few years.   I purchased them originally when I lived in the city and go not hear spouse who snores.   I purchased the Ozlo 2 just the other day and have used them 2 nights now.   The Ozlo 2 is worth the money - better sound and longer battery are amazing!  Thanks Ozlo

reviews.title: Well worth the price
reviews.text:
Amazing product! Unsure of earlier generations, this is my first Ozlo product, but they nailed it. The tech for customizing sleep sounds, when they start, how they integrate to your phone, etc is extremely well done. I like doing meditations to help quiet my brain before sleep, but am always annoyed that you have to end a session, put away earbuds, etc before going back to sleep. Now I can set a meditation, when it ends, go straight into sleep noises, and not worry about taking anything out or turning anything off. It’s seamless. The ergonomics of the buds are also extremely well designed. I’m a side-sleeper and barely feel these in my ears. I use an Apple Watch and Oura Ring. Last night, apple had my sleep score at 99; Oura had my sleep score at 97 (highest I’ve ever had). 
Well worth the cost!

reviews.title: New update has screwed the pooch
reviews.text: Enjoyed using my sleep buds until this latest update five days ago. Now I am unable to stream music, because it will not pair to the Calm app or Spotify. And my sleep data is not being read now. Additionally, it is disconnecting from the case multiple times. Please fix this latest update!!

reviews.title: Tedious design
reviews.text: Suppose you’re frustrated you can’t sleep. You open this app and realize it takes 18 minutes of concentrated work to figure out how to change the sound.

reviews.title: Better than Bose!!
reviews.text: I had the Bose sleep buds and was very disappointed!!

reviews.title: Ads in a sleep app?
reviews.text: New app has ads for their products. Really? I’m trying to sleep over here!

reviews.title: Scammy data practices-beware!
reviews.text: This company’s app defaults to allowing data analytics to share all of your data. Every time you attempt to turn off this feature you will be hit with an error code and it will forcibly reactivate itself. This practice should be banned and the developers should be ashamed. The product is great but their data practices are concerning at best and truly unethical at worst.

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.text: Love my Ozlo sleepbuds.  Would be five stars but terrible customer service.

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text:
Hi Ozlo Support,

I’m extremely frustrated with my experience so far. I have clearly explained multiple times that my sleep buds are showing no power lights whatsoever and that the troubleshooting steps provided have already been attempted numerous times without success.

Despite this, I continue to receive the exact same diagnostic email instructing me to reset the buds, which is not possible because they will not power on.

I specifically purchased the insurance/replacement coverage to avoid situations like this. At this point, I am no longer seeking additional troubleshooting steps. I am requesting that my claim be escalated to a human representative and that a replacement under my coverage be processed immediately.

Please confirm receipt of this message and provide the next steps for replacement. If additional information is needed, I am happy to provide it, but repeating the same reset instructions is not resolving the issue.

Thank you,
Sean Stone

reviews.title: Good product. Annoying app.
reviews.text: Navigation is unnecessarily complicated and clunky. You get lost figuring out which menu has your downloaded tracks. You can only control volume from within the app - not the side buttons. The app is the enemy of intuitive use for people who are trying to get to or go back to sleep.

reviews.title: Misery
reviews.text: Bought two pairs because I heard great things. Neither pair have ever worked consistently. They say fully charged but don’t make it through a single night. When they bust (disconnect, go intermittent), then it is miserable on my sleep because I am awake and have to turn on the light to try and get them reconnected or rebooted!  It’s really miserable. The blinking lights are not intuitive. Should be a color like green or red if they are working or not. Have tried working with company support. Zero fixes. $500 for ineffective sleep device and frustration. With no guarantee that I know of. I keep going back to try the second pair. The first pair I threw out because they were so frustrating!

reviews.title: Aaaand it’s broken
reviews.text: Got a new phone and tried to pair app to earbuds and nothing has worked. Followed all instruction videos for resetting the case. Unpaired it with my phone, reset case manually, tapped the case like instructed, still no luck getting app to function with earbuds. Earbuds are pairing to phone and app somehow, though, since at some point during the resetting they will start playing Ozlo music. So now I have an expensive brick.

reviews.title: Near Perfect
reviews.text: Ozlo sleepbuds represent the next generation of better sleep technology.  After suffering with disrupted sleep for years, I discovered the Bose sleepbuds six years ago.   At the time, it was the first technology that offered relief and a good nights rest.  I was devastated  when they discontinued them, and frankly feared that when my Bose wore out there would be no alternative.  Ozlo to the rescue!  I watched with great hope and anticipation as the product was developed and ultimately launched. When the faithful day came and my Bose bit the dust, I joined team Ozlo— and am 110% satisfied.  They advanced the technology and battery life of the original Bose, including streaming capability.  This alone makes it a leader in the field.  Comfortable, reliable and backed by years of development.  Recommend without reservation.

reviews.title: Sleep
reviews.text: I’m an RN working nightshift which means sleeping during the day. It’s a difficult thing to do, the sun is out, the rest of the lives on per usual, and there can be so much noise. I thought I could solve both of these problems with a mask but it wasn’t for me as a side sleeper. These buds are amazing at blocking out sound, more so when audio is being played, but I digress. They’re extremely lightweight to the point you forget they’re in your ear and when I lay my head down on my pillow theres no discomfort, just nice noises to listen and relax to. Very happy I stumbled upon them (thank you Lindsey/Scrubhacks on YouTube, would never have known about them otherwise) a long time goal of mine has been to improve my sleep quantity and quality and these buds are helping take a big step in both directions. Thank you ozlo!!

reviews.title: Stops from cat from waking me up
reviews.text: My cat thinks I should wake up to play with her at midnight and 5 am every day. She’s been destroying my sleep for years. I have tried everything, but nothing works. Until Ozlo. Best sleep of my life.

reviews.title: Inconsistent & Buggy
reviews.text: These disconnect constantly and don’t work with other apps at all. I’ve followed every troubleshooting guide multiple time and keep hoping the next firmware update will resolve these basic issues, but nope. It doesn’t seem like basic improvements are a priority. So unfortunate and disappointing too because these could be so great. They disrupt my sleep so much I gave up on them.

reviews.title: Sweet Dreams
reviews.text: These Sleepbuds are super comfortable and easy to use.  I utilize a number of gadgets to sleep: AC unit, and a cooling device for my mattress and these buds drown out the noise with soothing masking sounds.  I’ve just started using them and so far I am loving them!

reviews.title: Does not stay connected
reviews.text: How can I fall asleep if the moment I take the connected earbuds out of the case and place in ears… the app say to put back in case and reconnect…. Every single time I try to use this product. Every single time I try to use this product. Every single time I try to use this product. Every single time I try to use this product. This round and round is ridiculous for such an expensive product.

reviews.title: Customer Service lacking
reviews.text: I have been having issue with the ear buds for some time. Customer service sent some steps but the problem was not resolved. In responding and reaching out via multiple channels, silence. My buds won’t work for longer than three minutes and customer service is as silent as my buds.

reviews.title: Finally
reviews.text: Finally I found something that works for me … I also where these at work to focus better!!

reviews.title: Love/hate/love
reviews.text:
Love these guys kept the Bose dream alive!! Hate that i have to slide the lid open, then closed, then wiggle the buds, then open and close a few more times, to activate a basic white noise. Bose Killed them on this feature. I used to slide the lid open put a bud in the ear and white noise was going. This is just a frustration disaster. I don’t want bluetooth transmitting all night to my head. Just want a default “on” when removed. Without having to hold my mouth just right and count the flashes. 
Once they are going.. love them. Grateful for the rest they provide.

reviews.title: Break Easily
reviews.text: I want to review these higher, but two pairs have just stopped working one day within 6 months of purchase. That’s too fast to die for the price.

reviews.title: Just what I was looking for.
reviews.text: They work as I expected. Very comfortable.

reviews.title: Sleepbuds disconnect immediately after removal from case
reviews.text: Not sure if this is an app or firmware issue, but I’m putting it here anyway. In the past month or so, my Sleepbuds no longer stay connected outside of the case at all. I used to be able to change the volume/sleep sound/alarm etc. while wearing them, at least for a brief period. Now they insta-disconnect when I put them in my ears, making it impossible to change the volume or anything else without putting them back in the case. Unacceptable.

reviews.title: Buds work well for their intended purpose
reviews.text: The Bluetooth implementation is straight from 1968. They connect when the case is closed. When the case is opened and then closed and the app was not yet open they don’t connect.  Bluetooth connectivity is a mess.

reviews.title: So I now need a new iPad?
reviews.text: So you are telling me I can’t use your earbuds now because I can’t upgrade the iOS because I have an older iPad?? That is some b.s. right there.  You mean I can’t use them AT ALL!!??  That sucks.  Theme to find a new sleep earbud that won’t make me spend even MORE money.

reviews.title: They were the best until they weren’t
reviews.text: I loved these things, they were the most comfortable sleepbud I ever tried (and I tried a lot!) they don’t make my ears itch and I can’t even feel them when they are in. I loved that I could stream whatever sound I wanted and then it would sense when I fell asleep and switch to another ambient sound of my choice. It was just enough to drown out my snoring husband without intruding on my sleep. However, recently the left bud has stopped connecting. I have tried all the troubleshooting steps and reached out to support 3 times. I have never heard back. I am so disappointed because these were the answer to my sleep woes and now I am back to trying to sleep through the sound of a freight train every night. I’m also mad because these were so expensive and they are broken in less than a year. Lastly, it’s so upsetting that support will not even respond.  Based on that I would have to advise people not to buy these.

reviews.title: Terrible ux for adding or updating sounds
reviews.text:
You can’t have them in your ears while adding new sounds. Space is limited so you need to remove one to add one. It takes several minutes each time and you can’t do anything else while waiting for them to transfer/update. 
Please find a way to update in the background or at least allow me to do other things in the app or in my phone while a sound transfers or updates.

reviews.title: Ozlo sleepbuds
reviews.text: Super effective and super nice put me to sleep almost instantly had tons of great options for sounds super convenient because of the alarm would wake me up instantly when I needed to get up, I would wake up feeling super energized and they’re super easy to use and set up.

reviews.title: Extremely glitchy, won't play sound after removing from case
reviews.text: Despite having it set to play automatically upon removing from case, it simply doesn't do anything half of the nights I try to use them. And to make things worse, the app immediately disables itself the second I remove a bud so I can't even fix the problem. So fed up.
Thank you very much for pursuing something great and bettering the lives of everyone who uses this product!!!!

reviews.title: Incredibly versatile
reviews.text: Excellent ear buds. Unbelievably comfortable to sleep in.  I love that they detect sleep and turn off or play the sound of your choice when you fall asleep!

reviews.title: Great product, increased sleep
reviews.text:
I am a lifelong troubled sleeper. I was gifted the Ozlo sleepbuds about a month ago and have used them nightly since. My sleep has improved quite a bit in that time. 

I love that they are comfortable and sense when you fall asleep. It stops whatever sound/show you are streaming and switches to whatever settings you select for that. The battery life is great, built in alarm is pleasant, available sound options are all decent. 

Here are some of the annoying features that kept them from being 5 stars - you cannot easily use them with more than one device (like iPad/iPhone); transferring sleep data can take several minutes; same with any changes/updates made to the buds; if you walk more than 10 feet from device the sound shuts off; sleep sense will cut off your show if you just lay there watching it and not sleeping (this was the most annoying one because you need to get your sound back from the sleep sound)

Even with the quirks they are still the best solution I’ve found.  I have had much deeper sleep, I am able to sleep longer and feel more rested.

reviews.title: Pleasant sleep
reviews.text: Best investment I’ve made in my sleep health in my life. You’ll love these!

reviews.title: Too many app upgrades!!
reviews.text:
I understand software compatibility updates and bug fixes are regularly needed. But app design updates are out of control!! 
Pick a winner and stick with it. (At least 9months or so geez) 
There’s got to be other ways to increase revenue than playing with the app so often. 
I’m a tech person. I can’t imagine the normies dealing with these constant changes and then subsequent issues with nightly connecting to the iPhone: I’m constantly troubleshooting paring issues after these updates. 
That’s what it feels like from ground zero. 
I love this product 
But take some lessons from Apple products. 
You’re gonna drive me away to look for alternatives with this continuous/sporadic connection issues following various updates.

reviews.title: Glitching
reviews.text: I started using the app 3 days ago, and every time, something glitches. The sleep analysis is useless so far.
